description: This file defines React components for a command dialog with autocomplete functionality, including dialog structure, input, list, and various command-related UI elements.

methods.name: CommandDialogTrigger
methods.description: React component that renders a trigger button for the command dialog.

methods.name: CommandDialogBackdrop
methods.description: React component for the backdrop overlay of the dialog.

methods.name: CommandDialogViewport
methods.description: React component for the viewport area of the dialog.

methods.name: CommandDialogPopup
methods.description: React component for the popup content of the dialog, including nested structure.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: React component wrapping Autocomplete with specific props for command input.

methods.name: CommandInput
methods.description: React component for the command input field with search icon.

methods.name: CommandList
methods.description: React component for the list of autocomplete options.

methods.name: CommandEmpty
methods.description: React component for empty state in autocomplete list.

methods.name: CommandPanel
methods.description: React component for the command panel container.

methods.name: CommandGroup
methods.description: React component for grouping autocomplete items.

methods.name: CommandGroupLabel
methods.description: React component for labels within command groups.

methods.name: CommandCollection
methods.description: React component for the collection of autocomplete items.

methods.name: CommandItem
methods.description: React component for individual autocomplete items.

methods.name: CommandSeparator
methods.description: React component for separator lines in autocomplete list.

methods.name: CommandShortcut
methods.description: React component for displaying keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: CommandFooter
methods.description: React component for the footer area of the command dialog.
